name: Watchfire
tagline: Keep four braziers blazing through the night — unless you are the Saboteur.
core_loop: Play one card to Feed a brazier with a higher card of its suit, Rake a low card under the top and roll the die to steal it, or Stash it for face value; then draw.
win_condition: Highest total of stashed card ranks plus brazier awards: each of the four braziers pays 2.5 x player count to every Keeper if its top is blazing (rank 10+), or to the Saboteur alone if it is not.
